about.title: About me
about.text: I'm a fullstack developer with experience building real products for businesses: management systems, lightweight ERPs, admin panels and internal tools. I like to work close to the business problem, understand the context and propose simple but powerful solutions.

contact.title: Shall we work together?
contact.text: If you want to talk about a project, a collaboration or a custom solution for your business, send me a message and let's see how I can help.

projectsPage.title: Selected Projects
projectsPage.subtitle: A selection of real-world projects where I designed, built, and scaled complete solutions.
projectsPage.ctaText: If you're interested in how I work or want to collaborate, feel free to reach out.

dma.title: Distribuidora DMA
dma.short: A full-featured B2B ERP system for managing sales, payments, customers, and financial operations.
highlights: Advanced payment module with discounts, surcharges, and check management
Role-based access control with multi-branch support

context.title: Project context
context.callout: The system was designed to replace manual workflows and scale with the business growth.
p: Distribuidora DMA required a custom-built ERP to replace manual and spreadsheet-based workflows.
The goal was to centralize sales, payments, customers, and financial data into a single scalable platform.

built.title: What I built
b: Complete admin dashboard with role and permission system
Advanced payment logic including financial cost proration and check handling
Scalable backend architecture using NestJS and MongoDB
built.note: This project is actively used in production and continues to evolve based on real business needs.

nova.title: Nõva Sushi
nova.short: A management platform designed to optimize operations, costs, and processes for a growing sushi brand.
highlights: Designed with scalability and franchising in mind

problem.title: The problem
problem.callout: As the business scaled, manual processes became a bottleneck.
p: As the brand grew, managing costs, inventory, and processes manually became inefficient.
There was a need for a system that aligned operational reality with financial control.

solution.title: The solution
b: Centralized management of menu items and costs
Clear operational workflows for daily use
Foundations for future franchise management features
